name: Marta Ros Florenza
bio: Marta Ros Florenza is a fashion stylist based between Paris and Barcelona, with a strong interest in image-making and the way clothes can tell a story. Her work moves between editorial and commercial projects, always guided by curiosity, intuition and a personal approach to styling.

infoArtwork.alt: Collage in magenta, blue, yellow and green: screen-printed hands, stars and fragments of faces
